_note: deco-indigo album DRAFT (Nov 7 late): Claude's own picks (coordinator 11:38pm). Holiday matches in their own section at the end.

groups.stand: Standouts: the six that look best together
groups.berry: Berry + teal: her faces, on the mat

mats.name: Peacock Garden
mats.why: Your Indigo pick from October. A navy center holds her backs, and the olive frame and paisley border give her a second color, so she doesn't fade into it.

mats.name: Savannah
mats.why: You put Indigo on the green mat in October. Deep green with pink and plum flowers: the navy backs stand out, and the pinks pick up her crak frames.

mats.name: Deco Dragon (Mulberry)
mats.why: Bam Bird Boutique's own Deco Dragon mat, in her sister color. The dragons match hers, and the berry plays off the navy instead of copying it.

mats.name: Caroline in Navy
mats.why: A navy center framed in magenta and berry blooms with teal leaves: her back, her craks and her bams in one mat.

mats.name: Astor
mats.why: Navy floral with berry and coral inside a navy-plum plaid border: navy plus her berry. The colour pull missed it (measured as blue/purple, not navy). (Found in the Nov 8 mat discovery.)

mats.name: Crown Jewels
mats.why: Navy with jewel-tone flowers and a gold line border. The gold matches the palm on every back.

mats.name: Hawthorne
mats.why: A plum center inside a navy and gold frame. Her back color on the border, her mulberry in the middle.

mats.name: Gilded Peacock
mats.why: Art deco on art deco: gold fan lines and peacock feathers on deep teal-green, with an ivory center like her faces.

mats.name: Pretty in Plum Premium
mats.why: Plum, lilac and ivory with a scalloped deco pattern: her mulberry faces, big, against navy backs.

mats.name: Garden Party – Mulberry
mats.why: A berry center with a teal edge. The berry pops off her navy, and the teal ties in her bams.

mats.name: Caroline in Peacock
mats.why: A peacock teal center inside berry blooms: two of her face colors, none of her navy, so the backs stand out.

mats.name: Deco Dragon (Lagoon)
mats.why: Bam Bird Boutique's Lagoon Deco Dragon: her teal bams and green dragon, with the same dragons as the tiles.

mats.name: Navy and Red Pop
mats.why: Navy with wavy teal and pink lines and red stars. Fun and graphic; navy plus two of her face colors.

mats.name: Gatsby Glow
mats.why: Deco fans and a gold sunburst, from the same era as the tiles. The blue fans carry her backs, the gold carries her palm.

mats.name: SoHo
mats.why: Oh My Mahjong's deco sunburst in blue and green. Retired, but a match if you already own it.

mats.name: The Speakeasy
mats.why: Black with a gold deco frame. Simple and moody, and the gold frame matches the palm on her backs.

mats.name: Peacock Feathers
mats.why: A peacock in teal and lime on black, like her peacock wind tiles.

mats.name: Midnight Garden Club
mats.why: A navy center inside a mint and lilac floral frame: soft, and it lets her navy backs shine.

mats.name: Sapphire Blue Garden Mat
mats.why: A blue center inside a garden of pink, coral and yellow flowers. Bright, but every color is one of hers.

mats.name: Crane & Moon
mats.why: Deep teal with a gold moon, cranes and coral flowers. The crane is a twin of her 1 Bam.

mats.name: Elysium
mats.why: Oh My Mahjong's navy pagoda garden inside a bright green fretwork frame. Navy plus green.

mats.name: Calista Leatherette
mats.why: A navy center with a cream and sage floral frame and navy fretwork. Soft, and very her.

mats.name: Tilly Neoprene
mats.why: Lilac with a navy and berry floral frame: her navy and mulberry, softened.

mats.name: Moody
mats.why: A blue center inside a garden of pink and orange flowers on teal.

mats.name: Vanderbilt
mats.why: Navy and ivory plaid inside a gold deco-scallop frame: her navy back and gold palm. (Found in the Nov 8 mat discovery.)

mats.name: Butterscotch Floral Simple Middle
mats.why: A navy center with a gold line, inside peach and coral roses. Warm flowers against her cool navy. Amber is her complement on the wheel.

mats.name: Yuletide
mats.why: Holiday: Oh My Mahjong's green plaid with red lanterns. Green and red against navy backs.

mats.name: Love & Light
mats.why: Holiday (Hanukkah): navy with a gold menorah and blue stars. Navy on navy, but the gold matches her palm.

mats.name: Snowflake Reindeer Lodge Double-Sided Leatherette
mats.why: Holiday: a navy plaid with a big snowflake and reindeer. A winter look that keeps her navy.

mats.name: Alpine Snowflakes
mats.why: Holiday: cobalt with snowflakes and a green dot border. Brighter blue than her backs, but a fun winter table.

mats.name: Winter Jewel
mats.why: Holiday: deep teal with a red, ivory and teal snowflake medallion.
